targets.quote: The overall aim is to help Member States and stakeholders make the most of the significant support for heritage available under EU instruments, progress towards a more integrated approach at national and EU level, and ultimately make Europe a laboratory for heritage-based innovation
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: In line with the objectives of the European Agenda for Culture, this Communication presents the EU's approach to heritage across different policy areas (section 2).
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Therefore a more integrated approach to heritage conservation, promotion and valorisation is needed in order to take into account its manifold contribution to societal and economic objectives, as well as its impact on other public policies.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: to increase understanding of the actual and potential role of heritage in policy development, it is important to improve systematic data on its economic and social impacts.
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: heritage contributes through its direct and indirect economic potential, including the capacity to underpin our cultural and creative industries and inspire creators and thinkers
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: The heritage sector must also adapt management and business models and develop new professional skills, working with authorities not through one-off, isolated interventions, but by making the valorisation and preservation of heritage part of broader long-term development plans.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: encourage the modernisation of the heritage sector, raising awareness and engaging new audiences
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: apply a strategic approach to research and innovation, knowledge sharing and smart specialization;
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: seize the opportunities offered by digitisation; to reach out to new audiences and engage young people in particular;
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: continue developing more participative interpretation and governance models that are better suited to contemporary Europe, through greater involvement of the private sector and civil society.
targets.label: objective

targets.quote: Global warming and climate change, in particular rising sea levels and the increased occurrence of extreme weather events, can put cultural heritage at risk.
targets.label: other

targets.quote: Furthermore, research and innovation is carried out on strategies, methodologies and tools needed to enable a dynamic and sustainable cultural heritage in Europe in response to climate change and natural hazards and disasters.
targets.label: commitment

targets.quote: The Commission now invites all stakeholders to jointly look into how public policies at all levels, including the EU, could better be marshalled to draw out the long term and sustainability value of Europe's cultural heritage, and develop a more integrated approach to its preservation and valorisation.
targets.label: commitment
